long_biography.plain_text:
Numarine began with Ömer Malaz's frustration that existing motor yachts could not deliver the range, comfort and autonomy his family wanted at sea. He converted that user perspective into a manufacturing brief, assembled an international design team and built a purpose-made production base near Istanbul.

The 2008 downturn tested the young shipyard. Malaz formed a joint venture with Abraaj Capital, whose backing helped Numarine continue through the recession; he then bought the investor out and restored sole ownership in 2012. Under his direction, Numarine moved from high-performance craft toward long-range explorer yachts, combining technical production with a distinct design identity. The factory has since delivered a broad series of models for international markets, while Malaz now concentrates on long-term partnerships and brand direction.
